title: Phase-Free BindingSlots Read-Address Generalization and Routing-Gradient Isolation

hypotheses.H_A: a contrastive routing objective trained across diverse query forms and hard competitor slots makes the correct internal slot reliably top-ranked on held-out evaluation queries
hypotheses.H_G: projecting conflicting persistence/teacher gradients away from the LM gradient only inside write_addr_proj preserves routing supervision without the language-quality regression

exclusions: combining multiple untested mechanisms in one arm

arms.B0: corrected H2 unchanged (run_ag_arm levers off; training byte-identical to frozen run_h2)
arms.A1: B0 + contrastive read-address objective at real task-query positions (run_ag_arm use_a1)
arms.G1: B0 + PCGrad projection of aux gradient vs LM gradient in write_addr_proj only (use_g1)
arms.AG: B0 + A1 + G1 (run only if A1 and G1 both pass their gates; no third mechanism)

A1_objective.form: L_A1 = -log( r[query_pos, s*] + eps ), averaged over layers and batch (objectives.correct_slot_prob_loss, UNCHANGED); s* = argmax write-address at fact_pos
only_differences_from_prior: query distribution = real task-query positions across diverse query templates
hard-negative construction = content-similar/related/shuffled competitor facts in the same example
A1_objective.coefficient_schedule: objectives_persistence.o1r_lambda (same as the closest prior correct-slot objective); NO coefficient sweep
A1_objective.batch_rng: DEDICATED (seed*100003 + 8675309) so the main training data stream is byte-identical to B0
A1_objective.leakage_rule: the TEST template equals the frozen needle-eval query framing and is NEVER used for A1 training or coefficient selection; A1 trains only on the `train` partition

G1_objective.equation: g_aux_corrected = g_aux - min(0, dot(g_aux,g_lm)/||g_lm||^2) * g_lm ; final wak grad = g_lm + g_aux_corrected
G1_objective.scope: write_addr_proj (W_wk) parameters only, at the GROUP level; LM gradient never modified; no backbone projection; no loss-coefficient change; no separate optimizer; no other group altered
G1_objective.zero_lm_gradient_handling: if ||g_lm||^2 < 1e-12 no projection is applied (g_aux_corrected = g_aux) — deterministic, preregistered
G1_objective.implementation: main.backward() then aux.backward() (linearity gives identical non-wak grads to total.backward()); only wak grads rewritten; the frozen global clip_grad_norm_(1.0) and optimizer are unchanged and applied after projection
G1_objective.coefficient: aux terms keep their existing coefficients (lambda_align, h2_coefficient); the aux gradient carries them (formula lambda folded into g_aux)

primary_measurements.fixed_probe_metrics: SECONDARY diagnostics only, never the primary selection endpoint

all_required: ≥4/5 seeds clean-stable under the frozen classifier
eval-time correct-slot routing materially improves over paired B0
correct-slot top-1 accuracy improves on held-out query templates
the fixed probe does not improve while held-out eval routing remains unchanged (no probe-only gaming)
A1_mechanism_gate.materially_improves_and_approaches_oracl: FROZEN from merged clean-control distributions before execution (see thresholds_frozen)

all_required: negative LM-vs-aux alignment in write_addr_proj eliminated or materially reduced
retrieval and eval-time routing non-inferior to paired B0
no new conflict appears in another parameter group
optimizer step count and all other training semantics unchanged

thresholds_frozen.note: frozen from merged clean-control distributions (value-path phase clean seeds R0 s24, O1R s23, H2 s24) BEFORE execution; NOT derived from A1/G1 outcomes
thresholds_frozen.oracle_gap_close_definition: ordinary needle >= 0.80 * oracle-address needle on held-out eval queries
thresholds_frozen.g1_conflict_reduction_required: mean write_addr_proj LM-vs-aux cosine over the H2 teacher window >= -0.02 (from B0's materially-negative baseline), i.e. negative alignment eliminated or |cos| reduced by >= 50%

adaptive_futility.order: A+ x5, B0 x5, then A1 x5 and G1 x5 (each selectable arm sequential over 28-32)
adaptive_futility.rule: after the SECOND seed that makes the arm's 4/5 gate mathematically impossible, stop that arm as futile

prohibitions: do not implement external temporary memory
do not begin the next phase in this PR
